note: Which ElevenLabs voice speaks for which character. The voiceId values stay empty until the owner has listened to auditions and chosen (M4 phase H). modelId must be the exact id of the model the owner picks in ElevenLabs; it is left empty rather than guessed.
_settingsNote: Sent explicitly with every line (voice_gen refuses settings without stability and similarity_boost). Set by the voice-and-sound-director on 2026-11-02 from the approved audition (round 3, 2026-11-01): similarity 0.8 for all; stability 0.5 for the lines not named in styleRules (praise, correct answers, greetings, goodbyes), and the styles on top: cheer 0.35 (celebrations), ceremony 0.45, thinking 0.55, ask 0.60 (questions, 'not yet' and listening lines), hint 0.65 (hints 1 and 2), hint3 0.70. style and speed are never sent to a v4 model, so a style is a stability only. A rule that starts with * matches the END of the voice id (needs the B-45 change in voice_gen_lib.dart styleOf; until then those rules match nothing and the line is said at 0.5); every other rule matches the START. The first matching style wins, in the order written here. Reasons and the listening notes: docs/audio/b45-voicing-plan.md.
_priceNote: USD per 1,000 characters, list API prices (PLAN.md › costs), used only for the estimate that voice_gen plan prints. The owner's plan may differ; --price replaces them.
